summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved Postgres/asyncpg resilience plan: async engine liveness settings are configured, closed-connection classification and bounded retry helpers are present, API workspace list/detail reads retry through fresh sessions, health/status surfaces report DB_CONNECTION_CLOSED diagnostics, and worker scheduler, stale-active scan, and claim-refresh paths handle transient closed connections without terminally failing workspaces or losing ownership on a single stale connection. Regression coverage exists for the planned DB, worker, API, health, and service-status surfaces. Existing validation evidence in docs/awf-plans/ws_b9cdd9b1c3474951876ee21d.validation.txt shows all focused regressions, ruff, mypy, tests/unit, OpenAPI drift check under the repo virtualenv, and full coverage passed with 99.02% coverage.
